title: Aureline M5 notebook-document-header component
description: Documents the controlled vocabulary the notebook_document_header family binds inside the frozen M5 notebook-kernel-output component matrix (schemas/ui/m5-notebook-kernel-output-component-matrix.schema.json). A notebook document header names where a notebook came from and where its canonical .ipynb identity stands so a header never leaves a notebook's canonical identity or its local / remote / managed source implicit. The Rust validator in crates/aureline-notebook is the authoritative gate; this schema documents the family's shape.
